_comment: Usage governor budgets for the Spotlight Now pipeline (renamed from Trendline Now 2026-11-24) (2026-11-23). Free-tier limits, verified Nov 2026; the governor never lets a prep burn through them. Daily windows reset at midnight America/Toronto; monthly windows on the 1st (Toronto time); hourly windows on the hour. A provider with no numeric budget is still governed: a 429/limit response cools it (cooldown_after_429_seconds) instead of being retried in a tight loop. See hidden_files/governor.md. Daily cap is 2 max (Rishi 2026-11-24: quality over quantity); 1/day when top-quality image supply (FLUX) is short — the pool fails loudly on FLUX exhaustion rather than filling with weak legs. Do NOT put secrets in this file.

azure-tts.label: Azure Speech F0 neural TTS (DavisNeural voice)
azure-tts.note: 500,000 neural-TTS chars/month. ~8,500 chars/video = ~55 videos/month. At 90% the TTS pool switches to the Google voice to preserve the last 10%; hard stop at 100%.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Workers AI Llama 3.3 70B (script)
cloudflare.note: Units are Workers AI neurons (10,000/day free), SHARED by the script leg (~926 neurons/act) and FLUX images (~173/image, bake-off 2026-11-24). Script + image can never exceed 10k/day combined because there is only one ledger entry. A 4006 quota error cools until 00:00 UTC (the Cloudflare reset; the ledger day itself is midnight America/Toronto, so the ledger can over-allow across the 5h boundary — the live 4006 is the hard backstop). A 60-scene video needs ~10,380 neurons of FLUX alone, so FLUX can never cover a full video in one day; the chain falls through to Pexels + OVH for the tail by design.

gemini.label: Gemini Flash-Lite (script, new project key)
gemini.note: 500 requests/day per the codebase (ScriptProviderFactory header). KEY-BLOCKED until Rishi adds the new-project key; the governor enforces the cap once the leg activates.

google-tts.label: Google Cloud TTS (fallback voice)
google-tts.note: 1,000,000 chars/month standard voices (conservative; GenConfig cites 4M standard / 1M WaveNet — the governor uses the lower figure so it never overshoots).

groq.label: Groq gpt-oss-120b (script)
groq.note: 200K tokens/day binds first (~8 scripts/day at ~25K tokens/script). TPM 8K is a per-minute trip the groq helper already retries internally; the governor keeps the daily cap honest.

kilo.label: Kilo Gateway openrouter/free (script)
kilo.note: 200 requests/hour per IP, no published daily cap. Latency-bound, not count-bound (~9 min/script when Groq is down).

leonardo-image.label: Leonardo (image)
leonardo-image.note: DORMANT: no custom.leonardo connection exists and no model id is configured (GenConfig.LeonardoModelId empty). Confirm the free daily allowance still applies before activating — Leonardo API generations spend API credits. No budget until tested live.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter :free (script)
openrouter.note: 50 requests/day unfunded. KEY-BLOCKED until Rishi adds the key.

ovhcloud.label: OVHcloud gpt-oss-120b (script)
ovhcloud.note: Chat endpoint (kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net). No published budget; governed by 429-cooldown only. Distinct from the OVHcloud image endpoint.

ovhcloud-image.label: OVHcloud SDXL (image)
ovhcloud-image.note: 2 requests/min, anonymous shared bucket. A 429 means the bucket is empty — cool 15 min, do not retry in a tight loop. Filler only in the rebuilt pool (~10-15 scenes/video); SDXL retires 2027-02-10.

pexels.label: Pexels stock photo (image, supplement only)
pexels.note: Free tier: 200 requests/hour, 20,000/month. Real photos, not AI art — the #2 leg for news scenes (bake-off 2026-11-24), after Cloudflare FLUX. Query is topic/entity keywords; --seen-file dedupes photos per job.

pollinations-keyed.label: Pollinations keyed FLUX (image)
pollinations-keyed.note: DORMANT until Pollen exists (balance 0, 2026-11-24): a $0 balance fails fast with HTTP 402 and the chain logs the leg dormant for the rest of the run. No budget — the keyed endpoint is not a free-tier bucket; activate only after a Pollen top-up, then add a budget here if one applies.

pollinations-text.label: Pollinations text (script, last resort)
pollinations-text.note: No published budget; governed by 429-cooldown only. Scripts from this leg alone run short (54 scenes / 5,407 chars in the 2026-11-23 dry run).

wikimedia.label: Wikimedia Commons real photos (image, star pre-leg)
wikimedia.note: Freely licensed (CC BY / CC BY-SA / public domain) real photos of the actual person — tried BEFORE FLUX, only when a scene names a ranked star (StarRanking, Rishi 2026-11-24). No key, public API, no published budget; governed by 429-cooldown only. CC BY images need attribution in the video description — the Commons title + licence are printed on the artpool success line for the prep log.

youtube.label: YouTube Data API v3 (topic pick)
youtube.note: 10,000 units/day; ~1,100 units per topic pick = ~9 picks/day. Budget tracked in the ledger; the topic-pick call site is NOT yet wired to the governor (follow-up).

zai.label: Z.ai GLM-4.7-Flash (script)
zai.note: No published free-tier budget found; governed by 429-cooldown only. Key added 2026-11-24; activation test running.
